en_title: GTA 6 Has an 'Advanced' Weather System, but How Will It Work?
cn_title: 《GTA6》确认拥有「先进」天气系统，效果如何？
subtitle: 风暴将至？
opus_summary: 《GTA6》将采用模拟佛罗里达恶劣天气的「先进」天气系统，引发玩家对飓风等动态天气的猜测。Game Informer的14页封面报道将于9月29日公开更多细节。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is confirmed to have an "advanced" weather system, leading many to wonder if we're going to get tropical storms.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》已确认拥有「先进」天气系统，许多人因此猜测游戏中是否会出现热带风暴。

paragraphs.en: Game Informer has confirmed that GTA 6 will be the magazine's cover story this month and as a result, it will feature a treasure trove of new details about the game. The 14-page story will feature exclusive interviews and screenshots and while we're still waiting to find out all the specifics, Game Informer did confirm it will dive into the game's "advanced weather systems that simulate Florida’s less sunny weather phenomena."
paragraphs.cn: Game Informer确认，《GTA6》将成为该杂志本月的封面报道，因此文章会带来大量游戏新细节。这篇14页的报道将包含独家采访和截图。虽然具体内容仍有待揭晓，但Game Informer已经确认，报道将深入介绍游戏中的「先进天气系统」，该系统会模拟佛罗里达州那些不那么阳光明媚的天气现象。

paragraphs.en: Although we'll have to wait to learn more about what that means, this tidbit has resulted in a flurry of speculation. GTA 6 is set in Leonida, a fictional version of Florida, which has many wondering if there will be intense weather systems such as hurricanes. Game Informer's tease suggests that Rockstar is finally going to reveal the limits of its weather system, but one has to imagine it will go further than previous Rockstar titles.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然我们还要等待更多信息，才能了解这究竟意味着什么，但这条消息已经引发了大量猜测。《GTA6》的舞台位于Leonida——一个以佛罗里达州为原型的虚构地区——许多人因此想知道游戏中是否会出现飓风之类的强烈天气系统。Game Informer的预告暗示，Rockstar终于要揭晓其天气系统的极限，但可以想见，这套系统的表现应该会超越Rockstar此前的作品。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is a technically ambitious game, but having something like a hurricane outside of a scripted event or mission seems like a daunting task for the developers. It could change the map, create unique gameplay obstacles, and really stir things up in complex ways. Up until now, Rockstar has been cagey when asked about its plans for weather. It's possible the studio was still trying to finetune these systems before saying anything, as to avoid getting anyone's hopes up, but hopefully it has designed something that goes beyond a simple rain shower.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》在技术层面野心十足，但要在脚本事件或任务之外实现飓风之类的天气，对开发者来说似乎是项艰巨任务。它可能改变地图、制造独特的玩法障碍，并以复杂的方式彻底搅乱游戏局势。到目前为止，Rockstar在被问及天气计划时始终含糊其辞。也许该工作室此前还在继续调整这些系统，不愿过早透露消息，以免让玩家抱有过高期待；但希望他们确实设计出了超越简单降雨的效果。

paragraphs.en: Red Dead Redemption 2 had some pretty intense storms which featured intimidating lightning and thunder, big gusts of wind, and spooky dark clouds. The game also featured snow and dust storms in relevant parts of the map. It's unlikely we'll see either of those return in a parody of the sunshine state, but it's clear that Rockstar likes to create dynamic circumstances to make the world feel more alive and potentially add more challenges.
paragraphs.cn: 《荒野大镖客：救赎2》中曾出现过相当猛烈的风暴，伴随着令人畏惧的闪电和雷声、强劲阵风，以及阴森的乌云。游戏还在地图的相关区域加入了暴风雪和沙尘暴。在这款以阳光之州为戏仿对象的作品中，我们不太可能看到这两种天气回归，但很明显，Rockstar喜欢创造动态环境，让世界显得更加鲜活，也有可能借此增加更多挑战。

paragraphs.en: Game Informer's story goes live tomorrow, September 29, so we'll be able to mull over all of the details soon. However, there are no shortage of details about GTA 6's in IGN's own preview of the game from earlier this summer. It's unclear if or when we'll get another trailer for the game, but hopefully, it won't be too much longer.
paragraphs.cn: Game Informer的报道将于明天，也就是9月29日上线，我们很快就能仔细研究全部细节。不过，IGN在今年夏季早些时候发布的游戏前瞻中，也已经透露了不少《GTA6》相关信息。目前还不清楚我们是否会看到游戏的下一支预告片，也不知道它何时发布，但希望这一天不会让我们等太久。
